what if they are the same number?

no monitor returns a point

any monitor is itself a finite process — finite states, finite bandwidth, finite time

a monitor maps a real quantity  ->  one of |S| outputs

  |S|      finite            the monitor's own state space
  range(q) uncountable       a continuous physical quantity

  so some output cell has diameter  >=  β  >  0

every identification carries irreducible residual uncertainty. Not from noise, and not from the instrument being cheap — from the observer being finite.

this is the same floor β as the medium argument: the least distinguishable difference. There it decided whether a reaction had a direction; here it decides how finely anything can be scheduled.

so the quantum is derived, not configured. Setting τ = β is the tightest granularity that is consistent with what can be observed at all.

three-way equivalence

for an assignment A and a price vector p, these are the same condition

conditionreads as
(i)yield-optimalityno assignment does better
(ii)deterministic closureno single reassignment helps

equivalent up to a slack of exactly one tick — proved as a cyclic implication (i) ⇒ (ii) ⇒ (iii) ⇒ (i)

and when one τ plays all three roles, the slack is zero: one fixed point

the closed set has three members and the clearing set has one — so closure alone is weaker than clearing, and the equivalence is doing real work rather than restating a definition

live

a check that failed

the first form of the utilisation theorem stated a slot's contribution as a ratio

  original    Y(v) = pressure / ( τ · c · g(v) )

  strictly DECREASING in v  ->  argmax is the boundary v -> 0+
  its stated first-order condition has NO interior root

  the numerical check correctly FAILED

the fix is a different functional form, not a different constant — concave benefit minus convex cost:

  corrected   Y(v) = pressure · b(v)  −  τ · c · g(v)

  strictly concave  ->  unique interior optimum   v* = 0.4316

the failure is recorded in the theorem's own footnote. A suite that only confirmed what the paper already said would have shipped the boundary solution.

confirm or decline

a monitoring process terminates in one of two states. There is no third.

confirmed

evidence has narrowed the cell past the confirmation threshold. Act.

declined

no further evidence reduces the cell below β. Withhold the action — and say so.

finitely many finite sources give a finite evidence graph, so the process must halt — and every terminal state is one or the other

the same shape as the two refusals in the medium argument, and as the allocator that declines a budget it cannot spend well. Three methods, three refusals, one reason: a bounded observer cannot manufacture resolution it does not have.

coherence requires three

how many independent sources does a monitor need to survive the arbitrary failure of one?

2

mutual support only — remove either and the other is unsupported

3

the cycle survives any single removal

so a pair of cross-checking sensors is one point of failure, not two independent ones — an if-and-only-if, not a heuristic

the monitor cannot be the controller

a subsystem that acts on its own observations cannot be an unbiased monitor of what it controls

monitor reads state h
↓
controller acts on that reading
↓
the next reading is of a state the action caused

the induced bias is at least the floor β — bounded below, so it does not average away with more samples

the consequence is architectural: monitoring and control must not close a loop inside one sampling period. That is a design rule derived from the floor, not a convention.

it drains, and there is a bound

a stalled queue raises its own separation cost — and that price is the signal that summons an executor. So local descent drains everything.

what this does not establish

stated explicitly, because the gap between the theory and a deployment is wide

not establishedwhat it would take
that any of this runs a real clusterthe checks are simulations and enumerations of small instances. Nothing here has scheduled real work.
that the floor is reachable in practiceβ is derived from finiteness, not measured on an instrument. Its numeric value on real hardware is unknown.
equivalence beyond small instancesthe enumeration is 4 tasks on 4 slots — the proof is general, the check is not
the benefit function b(v)a modelling choice, like the medium's weight. Only concavity is load-bearing, and only concavity is tested.
